text: Give an AI agent money and you have a problem with three parts.
say: Give an A.I. agent money, and you have a problem with three parts.

text: It can be prompt-injected. Its key can leak. And its judgement is not yours.
say: It can be prompt injected. Its key can leak. And its judgement is not yours.

text: Every existing answer buys safety with something you must trust: hardware, or seconds of proving.
say: Every existing answer buys safety with something you must trust. Hardware, or tens of seconds of proving.

text: Docket stops asking whether the agent is trustworthy.
say: Docket stops asking whether the agent is trustworthy.

text: It records what a contract actually let it do. Live, on Monad testnet.
say: It records what a contract actually let it do. Live, on Monad testnet.

text: This is the live console. No wallet, no signing — it reads public chain state.
say: This is the live console. No wallet, and nothing to sign. It reads public chain state.

text: A mandate holds the funds and the policy. The agent holds neither.
say: A mandate holds the funds and the policy. The agent holds neither.

text: It is granted permission to call one function — so stealing its key gets an attacker nothing it could not already do.
say: It is granted permission to call one function. So stealing that key gets an attacker nothing the agent could not already do.

text: A real deployed mandate, holding just under one MON, in ENFORCE mode.
say: A real deployed mandate, holding just under one mon, in enforce mode.

text: 53 acts recorded — read from the contract's own nonce, not from anything this page chose to count.
say: Fifty three acts recorded. That is read from the contract's own nonce, not from anything this page chose to count.

text: Every attempt the agent has made, each a permanent public record with its block number.
say: Every attempt the agent has made. Each one a permanent public record, with its block number.

text: A full walk is 42,000 requests. This reads a published manifest of act-bearing blocks instead.
say: Walking the chain for these is forty two thousand requests. This reads a published manifest of act bearing blocks instead.

text: And it proves that list complete against the chain's nonce before showing you a single row.
say: And it proves that list complete against the chain's own nonce before it shows you a single row.

text: The conduct score. 424 out of 1000.
say: The conduct score. Four hundred and twenty four, out of one thousand.

text: Computed in your browser from the mandate's own event log.
say: Computed in your browser, from the mandate's own event log.

text: It matches the number published to the ERC-8004 registry — posted by an address that owns nothing.
say: And it matches the number published to the E.R.C. eight thousand and four reputation registry. Posted by an address that owns nothing.

text: The registry refuses feedback from the agent's own owner. This score could not have been self-awarded.
say: The registry refuses feedback from the agent's own owner. So this score could not have been self awarded.

text: The spec is public and deterministic. No floating point anywhere.
say: The scoring spec is public and deterministic. No floating point, anywhere.

text: Every quantity is an integer in parts per million, so anyone reproduces it byte-identically, in any language.
say: Every quantity is an integer in parts per million, so a third party reproduces the number byte identically, in any language.

text: Four terms move it: experience, age, authority, and breach.
say: Four terms move it. Experience, age, authority, and breach.

text: Every refusal is a penalty that halves every thirty days. Age saturates at 180 — it cannot be bought.
say: Every refusal is a penalty that halves every thirty days. And age saturates at one hundred and eighty days. It cannot be bought.

text: Six invariants define the project.
say: Six invariants define the project.

text: The one that matters most: a policy violation never reverts.
say: The one that matters most. A policy violation never reverts.

text: It emits Denied and returns false. A revert would roll back its own logs — the refused attempt would vanish.
say: It emits denied, and returns false. A revert would roll back its own logs, so the refused attempt, the artifact the whole system rests on, would vanish.

text: The cost of a policy check, measured on testnet: 568 milliseconds, act to finality.
say: And the cost of a policy check, measured on testnet rather than argued: five hundred and sixty eight milliseconds, act to finality.

text: A zero-knowledge gate buys the same guarantee for 30 to 75 seconds. This one is a pause.
say: A zero knowledge gate buys the same guarantee for thirty to seventy five seconds. This one is a pause.

text: And the threat model says what this does not protect you from.
say: And the threat model says what this does not protect you from.

text: Fourteen rows — including that on this deployment the guardian and the owner are the same key.
say: Fourteen rows. Including the admission that on this deployment, the guardian and the owner are the same key.

text: Open the console. Read the spec. Recompute the score yourself.
say: Open the console. Read the spec. Recompute the score yourself.

text: Docket — an AI agent's reputation, computed from what a contract actually let it do.
say: Docket. An A.I. agent's reputation, computed from what a contract actually let it do.
